text:
harry: quick sync: proposing a 'contextual toast' pattern for deep links that target sub-views in the console. Instead of forcing full leftnav expansion, show a transient contextual toast + optional in-panel reveal. Want feedback on URL contract, focus behavior, and share semantics.
meera: interesting. can you sketch the URL shape? is it query, hash, or a mix?
harry: idea: keep canonical path stable + `?ctx=view` and optional `#anchor`. e.g. `/console/models/kk9?ctx=metrics#p95`. Behavior: land on resource, show a small toast with "Open Metrics" CTA (and auto-open if `?autoOpen=1`). This avoids surprise expands but keeps shareability.
toni: love that for low-disruption flows. accessibility check: if autoOpen happens we must move focus into the panel heading and announce it. If it's just a toast, toast must be accessible (aria-live polite) and keyboard focusable.
meera: plus one for toast-first. People lose context when everything auto-expands. Give users an explicit affordance. But we still need a path for power-links (autoOpen). `?ctx=metrics&autoOpen=1#p95` would open the panel and jump.
sam: history rule: if autoOpen is present, treat as initial reveal and use replaceState so back doesn't become a toggle. If user clicks the toast CTA to open, pushState so it's a deliberate navigation.
router-bot: route-scan: found overlaps with existing handlers for `?panel=` and `?view=` shapes. Recommend central parser that recognizes `ctx`, `view`, and `panel` aliases.
a11y-checker: checklist start: 1) toast announced via `aria-live='polite'` 2) toast CTA focusable 3) if autoOpen -> focus panel heading and add `role='region' aria-labelledby` 4) restore focus to origin on close.
harry: implementation sketch: if `autoOpen` present -> show skeleton for panel, wait for resource/data, mount panel, set `tabindex='-1'` on heading, focus({preventScroll:true}), then scrollIntoView. If only toast present -> do not mount panel until user clicks CTA.
toni: code sample for replace vs push: ```js
const u = new URL(location.href);
u.searchParams.set('ctx','metrics');
if (autoOpen) history.replaceState({}, '', u);
else history.pushState({}, '', u);
```
meera: highlight/share: support `?highlight=p95` that briefly pulses target when it exists. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and use `aria-describedby='shared-note'`. If toast-only flow and highlight present, include a link in the toast "Jump to p95" that will mount the panel and run deferred scroll.
sam: perf: for heavy pages we should avoid eager mounting. If `autoOpen` present we hydrate panel first; otherwise lazy-mount on CTA. Add `aria-busy=true` during fetch to communicate state. Deferred action queue needed for stale IDs.
a11y-checker: add tests: SR narration for "Metrics panel opened", keyboard-only flow (open via CTA), focus return on close (ESC/crumb), visible focus ring after JS focus, skip links unaffected.
harry: breadcrumb semantics: if panel opened (whether auto or CTA) append crumb ` / Metrics` so the state is discoverable and copyable. Clicking that crumb closes panel and uses replaceState to remove ctx param.
toni: UI note: toast should include concise copy + small icon and an accessible label for screen readers: `aria-label='Open Metrics panel for Model kk9'`. Avoid long toast copy.
meera: edgecase: if user lands with `autoOpen=1` but resource fetch fails -> show inline friendly message in toast "Couldn't open Metrics right now" and don't attempt focus/scroll. Fire analytics `nav.ctx_open_failed`.
sam: analytics: events `nav.ctx_toast_shown`, `nav.ctx_opened` with props {path, ctx, anchor, open_mode:'auto'|'cta', from_deeplink:true}. track focus-restore success boolean.
router-bot: note: centralize handler to `applyContextualDeepLink(params)` to avoid multiple route collisions. Also normalize URL (strip trailing slash, lowercase ids) to reduce duplicate shares.
a11y-checker: small suggestion: use `role='status'` or `aria-live='polite'` for toasts that are not interruptive. If autoOpen, add `aria-live='assertive'` string "Metrics panel opened" after focus change for SR clarity.
harry: good. I'll draft the pattern doc with examples, toast-first UX, autoOpen behaviour, replace/push rules, focus capture/restore utilities, deferred queue sketch, analytics schema, and accessibility QA checklist. Will open PR later today  can folks review?
meera: will do a UX pass.
toni: i'll write the a11y checklist and sample screen reader script.
sam: i'll review router and history implications.
router-bot: scheduled note: please run route-scan after PR merge to detect collisions.
harry: thanks all :sparkles:
